newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Wings & Wheels wins Benelux Nightfreight contract.
newsitem.headline: Wings & Wheels wins Benelux Nightfreight contract.

text.p: Dutch express trucking company, Wings & Wheels Express, said it has won a franchise contract from UK-based Nightfreight to carry out the latter's Benelux freight distribution.
Under the franchise contract, Wings & Wheels will operate daily express services between the UK and the Benelux, Edwin Beentjes, director of the Dutch company, told Reuters.
This move represents the first time Nightfreight has been active on the Continent although it has more than 50 depots in the UK, he added.
Wings & Wheels Express, which is around two years old, will hold the franchise contract under the name Nightfreight Benelux.
As well as the UK and Benelux, the Amsterdam Schiphol-based company will distribute express consignments to Germany, Denmark and Italy.
In Germany and Denmark, the company will work with other Nightfreight franchise holders.
Beentjes said although express packages are the speciality of the company, there will not be weight restrictions imposed.
"We will offer a whole variety of services from next day, to two or three day deliveries," he said.
Initially, four trucks and eight employees will be working for Nightfreight Benelux.
